Foundation Labs research

Four studies on how AI chooses its sources.

Original investigations I authored for Foundation Marketing’s research lab.

n8n01 16% The Ghost CitationOf the citations behind n8n’s AI answers, only about 16% came from n8n’s own sites. ClickUp02 0/12 Model DriftNamed in 97.5% of discovery answers, recommended in none of 12 head-to-head comparisons. ATS category03 73% The Versus LayerOf the evidence in head-to-head answers, 73% came from outside the vendors being compared. Docker04 54% The Docs DividendDocs were 54% of Docker’s own citations, but scale and upkeep explained the lead.
